general.new_controls.description: Expose separate Guard, Substitution, Item Select L and R actions and an Unbound choice in ordered selectors without the native editor's eight-action permutation restriction.

skip_native_item_select_badge.description: Branch past the native item-select badge draw, which reads P1's binding for both panels and draws an empty frame for an unbound action.

preserve_substitution_when_opening_assig.description: Stop the native editor from rewriting Guard/Sub 2 at index 7 to Guard/Sub 1 at index 6 when its assignment selector opens.

queue_control_settings_help_on_reset.description: Queue the Controls help instruction during the shared reset, before the first Controls draw.

select_held_guard_behavior.description: Accept the added Substitution binding after timing admission; otherwise preserve the vanilla held-Guard limit for native Guard/Sub input.

select_substitution_history_action.description: Search both native Guard/Sub bindings and the added Substitution binding independently in buffered input.

select_logical_block_source.description: Keep native Guard/Sub 2 and the added Guard binding as logical Guard sources.

load_extended_action_labels_high.description: Point the Control Settings renderer at the eleven-action label table.

load_extended_action_labels_low.description: Complete the extended action-label table address.

open_extended_bindings.description: Read the native bindings plus added Guard, Substitution, and Item Select R into the eight physical-button rows.

commit_extended_bindings.description: Write the native bindings plus added Guard, Substitution, and Item Select R without indexing past the native eight-action table.

skip_zero_native_binding.description: Keep an unbound native action from matching a buffered button press.

select_item_select_r.description: Deliver Item Select L and R presses through the native item-select and reverse item-select input bits.

draw_item_select_badges.description: Draw the bound Item Select L and R badges from the panel's own side before the item wheel.

reverse_item_select.description: Step the selected battle item backward when the reverse item-select input arrives.

replace_paired_action_assignment.description: Replace the native Guard-pair assignment helper with an owned one-action swap so both Guard/Sub slots and the added actions remain independently assignable.

order_face_actions.description: Step face rows through Unbound, Attack, Ultimate Jutsu Prep, Item Use, and Jump.

order_shoulder_actions.description: Step shoulder rows through Unbound, Substitution, Guard, Item Select L, Item Select R, and Linked Attack.

load_default_bindings_for_profile_init_h.description: Read the generated default layout when initializing the controller banks.

load_default_bindings_for_profile_init_l.description: Complete the generated default-binding table address.

load_default_bindings_for_bank_reset_hig.description: Read the generated default layout when resetting every controller bank.

load_default_bindings_for_bank_reset_low.description: Complete the generated default-binding table address.

load_default_bindings_for_player_reset_h.description: Read the generated default layout when resetting one player's bindings.

load_default_bindings_for_player_reset_l.description: Complete the generated default-binding table address.

load_default_bindings_for_battle_input_h.description: Read the generated default layout when a battle input object has no profile.

load_default_bindings_for_battle_input_l.description: Complete the generated default-binding table address.

reset_rows_from_default_layout.description: Fill the Control Settings Select reset rows from the generated default layout.

general.battle_results_rematch.description: Offer Circle Rematch on Free Battle results while retaining the saved matchup and session outcome counters.

general.music_override.description: Select existing SOUND.AFS music tracks for Mode Select and Character Select, repeating track 68 while it remains active and applying reduced gain.

select_character_music_track.description: Pass SOUND.AFS/000 track 68 to the Character Select music command.

select_mode_music_track.description: Pass SOUND.AFS/000 track 62 to the Mode Select music command.

route_mode_music_through_native_replacem.description: Replace the fixed track-1 preset with the selected Mode Select track while retaining native stop-before-replace behavior.

route_character_music_through_native_rep.description: Replace the fixed track-1 preset with the selected Character Select track, retain native stop-before-replace behavior, and apply gain -40.

restart_active_character_music_after_com.description: Preserve the shared battle-process pause update and restart finished channel-0 track 68 across battle setup screens.

select.description: Select one existing streamed-music track while preserving native replacement and global-volume behavior.

update.description: Run the shared battle-process pause update, then restart channel-0 track 68 only when its selected stream has finished.

general.practice_stage_select.description: Open the native Stage Select in Practice while retaining the training field as its initial choice.

initialize_interactive_practice_stage_se.description: Pass the native interactive sentinel only for Practice and preserve every other battle entry's initializer argument.

reset_initial_preparation.description: Restore one-controller Practice preparation before the selector's initial preparation reset.

reset_selected_stage_preparation.description: Restore one-controller Practice preparation each time a stage is confirmed, including after cancellation and reselection.

practice_stage_select_initialize.description: Initialize Practice Stage Select interactively and delegate other battle entries unchanged.

practice_stage_select_reset_preparation.description: Set Practice preparation to 1P versus COM before the native reset without changing its saved Status setting.

general.stage_selection_persistence.description: Restore the last highlighted stage when the native Stage Select opens again in Free Battle or Practice during the current session.

edit.description: Keep the selector initializer's saved-stage choice when the active stage has been cleared instead of replacing it with slot zero.

remember_cancelled_stage_selection.description: Save the highlighted Free Battle or Practice stage before the cancelled selector is destroyed.

apply_saved_practice_stage.description: Apply the saved Practice stage after selector initialization, falling back to the native training-field default when no saved stage exists.

stage_selection_persistence_update.description: Run the native selector update and remember the highlighted stage when Free Battle or Practice cancels it.

stage_selection_persistence_apply_initia.description: Use a saved Practice stage when present and otherwise apply the native initial stage.

general.mode_availability.remove_adventu.description: Mark the Adventure Mode Select entry unavailable.

general.mode_availability.remove_shop.description: Mark the Shop Mode Select entry unavailable.

general.unlock_all.description: Expose fully unlocked content and optionally assign the dormant Demon Wind Bomb selector only to Classic Naruto without changing live save data.

route_character_unlock_read_through_boun.description: Replace only the character-status byte read with the fully unlocked reference result for one bounded character ID; native callers retain their metadata filters.

route_character_form_progress_read_throu.description: Replace only the Character Select R1-form progression read with the fully unlocked reference value.

route_demon_wind_bomb_through_classic_na.description: Replace the native special-compatibility call with a wrapper that admits only Classic Naruto for selector 0x35 and delegates every other pair unchanged.

route_grouped_unlock_read_through_refere.description: Replace only the bounded grouped-availability byte read with unlocked values, including the native stable state for Collection figures.

route_jutsu_unlock_read_after_native_met.description: Return available only after the native character-and-jutsu metadata checks accept the pair.

route_progress_read_through_ultimate_dif.description: Report progress slot 0x6A available so the sixth Ultimate difficulty value remains selectable, while preserving native reads for every other progress slot.

route_secondary_unlock_read_through_boun.description: Replace only the secondary-availability bit read with the fully unlocked reference bit range.

route_small_unlock_read_through_bounded_.description: Replace only the 32-byte availability-table read with the fully unlocked reference values.

compatibility.description: Admit Demon Wind Bomb only for Classic Naruto when configured and retain the native special-compatibility result otherwise.

character.description: Return available for one of the 94 character-status entries enabled by the fully unlocked reference save.

character_form_progress.description: Return the fully unlocked saved-progress value used by Character Select's R1-form gate.

secondary.description: Return availability for one bounded secondary-content ID.

small_table.description: Return the fully unlocked value for one bounded small-table content ID.

grouped.description: Return an unlocked value for one bounded grouped content ID, using the native stable value for Collection figures.

jutsu.description: Return available for a character-and-jutsu pair already accepted by native metadata checks.

ultimate_difficulty.description: Report the Ultimate difficulty progress gate available while preserving native reads for every other progress ID.
